newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - TWO-YEAR T-BILLS TO DEBUT IN 1997 - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - TWO-YEAR T-BILLS TO DEBUT IN 1997 - REPORT.

text.p: Lithuania plans to issue Treasury bills with two and five-year maturities, the business newspaper Verslo Zinios reported on Wednesday.
"We plan to launch a two- year government T-bill issue this year and plan five year T-bills next year," Finance Minister Algirdas Shemeta was quoted as saying in the newspaper.

The minister was also quoted as saying that the T-bills will be in the local currency and he expected them to be in high demand as the infation level in the country was rather low and is forecast to fall further.
